title: Fess's band at the Villa
summary: Lineup of the Villa band with Fess: Eddie Atkins, Joe Howard, Baby Dodds, Leonard and himself on clarinet.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel

blocks.x: Yes. And, uh. Can you tell us about the band you played in with Fess at the Villa, is that what it's called?

Yeah, yeah. Uh, with, uh, with Fess I played, Zab was playing before I went there, you know. Zab. Yeah, yeah. So when, uh, when I went there, well, he had Eddie Atkin and, and, uh, Johnny Dot. Johnny Dot on the clarinet? No, no. His brother. Oh, Baby. Oh, Baby. Baby died, yeah. A new Baby.
Baby just died, you know, a couple months ago. Yeah, sure enough. In Chicago.
Uh-huh. And, uh, he had, uh, Leonard, I think, on, on, on Get There. Let's see. And Joe Howard had a trumpet. Oh. And Eddie Atkin on the, on the trombone. And, uh, I was on, uh, clarinet.

Do you remember, did the, was Eddie, uh, Dorsey or Dawson ever in the band there? Eddie Dorsey? Yeah, the bass player, did he ever play with you in that band? Eddie Dorsey. Yeah, or was he at the Entertainers, I believe? Eddie Dorsey.
Yeah, yeah, yeah, yeah. Uh, not, uh, what you call it, do you used to play a piccolo there? What his name? Uh.
